cohort: 5507 dichorionic twin deliveries occurring between 1991 and 2021 at Soroka University Medical Center
finding: Apart from birth weight differences, the birth order of dichorionic twins is not associated with adverse neonatal health indices or increased risk for morbidity during childhood.
mod_finding: Second-born twins had higher rates of cesarean deliveries.
birth_weight: Mentioned (second twins weighed 33g less on average)
